# squatch-dsp

> A small real-time C++17 sound engine for guitar effects: the Block/Arena/parameter core, limiter, noise gate, RBJ EQ and the Squatch Tuner, with thin hosts (JACK, a web page, WebAssembly in the browser). No fetched dependencies; make test runs ASan/UBSan/TSan suites including an allocation and lock watch.

391 tracked files; source by language (file count): C++ 223, Python 25, JavaScript 19, Shell 5, C 1.

Links are repository-relative paths. [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) inlines every linked file in this order. Both files are generated by project-kit `llms/generate.py` from tracked files; do not edit them by hand - the drift gate (`generate.py check`) fails when they are stale.

## Start here

- [squatch-dsp](README.md): A small real-time sound engine in C++17 for guitar effects: each block is written once and runs on a Raspberry Pi, a microcontroller, in a browser and in desktop plugins, with a thin host for each.
- [Contributing to squatch-dsp](CONTRIBUTING.md): Thank you for helping.
- [squatch-dsp roadmap](ROADMAP.md): Pi, on a microcontroller pedal, in a browser and in a desktop plugin, because it is the same code.
- [Third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md): squatch-dsp's own code is MIT (see LICENSE).

## Docs

- [Daisy Seed3: a Neural Amp Modeler on one Cortex-M7](docs/benchmarks/daisy-seed3.md): Measured on 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-17.
- [Pull request](.github/pull_request_template.md)
- [Squatch Tuner](blocks/tuner/README.md): A guitar and bass tuner core that reads a string to a tenth of a cent, built as a software strobe.
- [Squatch Tuner: measured results](blocks/tuner/RESULTS.md): Measured on 2026-09-23 on an Apple M1 Max (clang 21, `-O3`, no fast-math) with the code in this commit.
- [Tuner quality suite](blocks/tuner/bench/quality/README.md): Proves a tuner build is accurate and steady as a player sees it, with ground truth, on every platform.
- [Control contracts](contracts/README.md): One file per block, `<key>.params.json`, in the `cc.squatch.control/1` profile that squatch-skin defines (`schema/control.schema.json` there).
- [Desktop plugins: CLAP, VST3, AUv2](hosts/clap/README.md): `ClapPlugin<Block>` (`clap_plugin.hpp`) turns any squatch-dsp block into a CLAP plugin; clap-wrapper turns that into VST3 and AUv2.
- [squatch-dsp on the Daisy Seed3](hosts/daisy/README.md): Firmware that runs squatch-dsp blocks, and a Neural Amp Modeler (NAM) A2-Lite model, on an Electrosmith Daisy Seed3 (STM32H750, Cortex-M7 at 480 MHz, 128 KB internal flash).
- [Third-party notices for hosts/daisy](hosts/daisy/THIRD_PARTY.md): The firmware in this folder is MIT, like the rest of squatch-dsp.

## Optional

- [Squatch Tuner: CPU cost](blocks/tuner/results/perf.md): Object sizes (all of the memory, no heap): Tuner 128176 bytes, PolyTuner 233704 bytes, StrobeBank 116016 bytes, PartialChannel 14496 bytes.
- [Squatch Tuner: polyphonic accuracy](blocks/tuner/results/poly.md): Open strings from directinput_allsinglenotes.wav mixed with 0-40 ms spread and 0 to -6 dB levels; poly reading minus the mono reading of the same pluck alone, RMS c (p95 |diff|) [valid %]
- [Squatch Tuner: real DI accuracy, configuration variants](blocks/tuner/results/real-variants.md): Real DI: 275 notes that ring at least 1.5 s, from 2 file(s); each algorithm runs continuously over the whole file; re-pitch test +7.0 c.
- [Squatch Tuner: real DI accuracy](blocks/tuner/results/real.md): Real DI: 275 notes that ring at least 1.5 s, from 2 file(s); each algorithm runs continuously over the whole file; re-pitch test +7.0 c.
- [Squatch Tuner: synthetic accuracy](blocks/tuner/results/synth.md): Synthetic matrix: 12 notes E1..E6 x 8 trials, detune uniform ±50 c, 48 kHz input.
- [squatch-dsp CPU benchmark](results/bench-mac.md): Apple M1 Max, Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.3.34.2), `-O3 -fno-exceptions -fno-rtti`, 2026-09-26.
